column3: 了 (le): completed actions and change of state; 了 after the verb vs at the end
吗 (ma): yes/no questions
呢 (ne): "and you?", "where is...?" and ongoing actions
不 vs 没有: which negative to use
的 (de): possession and describing nouns
在 (zài): where something is, and where you do something
正在 / 在: talking about what is happening now
会, 能 and 可以: three ways to say "can"
想 vs 要: "want to", "would like to" and "will"
也 and 都: word order with "also" and "all"
几 vs 多少: asking "how many"
吧 (ba): suggestions and guesses
有点儿 vs 一点儿: "a bit"
太……了: "too" and "so"
再 (zài): "again" and "then" for future actions
Telling the time: 点, 分 and 半
Dates: 年, 月, 号 and days of the week
怎么 vs 怎么样: "how" and "how about"
比 (bǐ): comparing two things
过 (guo): saying you have done something before
着 (zhe): ongoing states
得 (de): describing how well someone does something
地 (de): turning a phrase into an adverb
的, 得 and 地: which de to use
虽然……但是: "although"
因为……所以: "because" and "so"
从……到: "from... to"
离 (lí): saying how far something is
已经……了: "already"
跟……一起: "together with"
让 (ràng): making or letting someone do something
还是: "or" in questions
最 (zuì): "the most"
就 (jiù): "right away", "as soon as" and "then"
被 (bèi): the passive voice
才 vs 就: "only then" vs "already"
如果……就: "if... then"
一边……一边: doing two things at once
又 vs 再: two ways to say "again"
更 (gèng): "even more"
跟……一样: "the same as"
除了……以外: "except" and "besides"
只要……就: "as long as"
先……然后: "first... then"
或者 vs 还是: two ways to say "or"
越……越: "the more... the more"
得 (děi), 必须 and 应该: "must" and "should"
刚 vs 刚才: "just"
以前 and 以后: "before" and "after"
